title: Check the hardest requests most
statement: Spot-check a generator's hardest requests most closely, since pass rates can fall steeply as the requested difficulty rises and requests for upper grades can come back simpler than asked.
example: Across 1,888 judged maths items, easy requests passed at 34.35% and hard ones at 14.14%.
detail: In one analysis of 1,888 judged maths items, pass rates fell from 34.35% for easy requests to 26.28% for medium and 14.14% for hard (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md`), and one grade's hard items passed at 1.54%, 1 of 65 (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/EXISTING_GRADES_ANALYSIS.md`). A separate generator's notes say that for upper grades 'Questions may be simpler than expected for grade level' and that 'Grades 9-10 produce elementary-level questions' (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/svg-llm/README.md`).
against: The gradient is not uniform: in one grade 'Performance is nearly identical across all difficulty levels', at 41.4%, 41.7% and 39.5% (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/AGENT2_GRADES_3_8_BASELINE.md`, line 60), and pass rates do not fall with grade, since grade 8 passed at 28.76% and grade 6 at 13.82% (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md`). The evidence is maths items only, and the upper-grade clause rests on one generator's notes.

evidence.quote: - Questions may be simpler than expected for grade level
